title: Aaj ruqsat ho rahi hai tumse zehra ya ali
body:
Alweda fatima Alweda Fatima
Haaye baad baba ke jo guzri wo musibat sunlo
Ya Ali (a.s) fatima Zehra (s.a) ki wasiyat sunlo
<<MINI>>
Aaj ruqsat ho rahi hai tumse Zehra (s.a) Ya Ali (a.s)
<<DIVIDER>>
Pardae shab me meri mayyat uthaana Ya Ali (a.s)
<<MINI>>
Aaj ruqsat ho rahi hai tumse Zehra (s.a) Ya Ali (a.s)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Pasliyaa todi gayi kaise ye batlaungi mai
hashr k maidaa'n me bhi is haal me aaungi mai
hath pehlu se na tum mera hataana Ya Ali (a.s)
<<MINI>>
Aaj ruqsat ho rahi hai tumse Zehra (s.a) Ya Ali (a.s) (2)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Wo Musibat aapne accha hua dekhi nahi
Ab mai sedhe hath se tasbih padh sakti nahi
Aisa kunfus(l.a) ne hai maara taziyaana Ya Ali (a.s)
<<MINI>>
Aaj ruqsat ho rahi hai tumse Zehra (s.a) Ya Ali (a.s) (2)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Haaye..... Kehti hai Zainab (s.a) ye mujhse dekhkar chehra mera
Aap ke ruqsar par ye neel ye kaisa pada
are maine khaaya hai tamacha mat bataana ya Ali (a.s)
<<MINI>>
Aaj ruqsat ho rahi hai tumse Zehra (s.a) Ya Ali (a.s) (2)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Taziyaane ki aziyat ka uthaana ek taraf
wo tamaache qatle mohsin dar jalaana ek taraf
sab se mushkil tha magar darbaar jaana Ya Ali (a.s)
<<MINI>>
Aaj ruqsat ho rahi hai tumse Zehra (s.a) Ya Ali (a.s) (2)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. jab meri talqeen padhna yaad karlena zara
dar ke girne se mera baazu bhi hai toota hua
mere shaano ko zara dheere hilaana Ya Ali (a.s)
<<MINI>>
Aaj ruqsat ho rahi hai tumse Zehra (s.a) Ya Ali (a.s) (2)
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Haaaye ..... Chahe aajaye qayamat mujhse ye waada karo
jab talak moula mere shabbir ki marzi na ho
tab talak mera janaaza mat uthaana Ya Ali (a.s)
<<MINI>>
Aaj ruqsat ho rahi hai tumse Zehra (s.a) Ya Ali (a.s) (2)
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Jab se aayi hoon palatkar fikr hai mujhko yahi
mai to parde me gayi phir bhi za'eefa hogai
berida darbaar hai Zainab (s.a) ko jaana Ya Ali (a.s)
<<MINI>>
Aaj ruqsat ho rahi hai tumse Zehra (s.a) Ya Ali (a.s) (2)
<<DIVIDER>>
8. karbala me jab mere mazloom par khajar chale
Pyaas ke aalam me wo Ghazi ko jab aawaaz de
mai bhi aaongi waha par tum bhi aana Ya Ali (a.s)
<<MINI>>
Aaj ruqsat ho rahi hai tumse Zehra (s.a) Ya Ali (a.s) (2)
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Hatj pehlu par rakhe boli takallum fatima
Mai dua karti hoon tum aameen kehdena zara
jald aaye mere mehdi ka zamaana Ya Ali (a.s)
<<MINI>>
Aaj ruqsat ho rahi hai tumse Zehra (s.a) Ya Ali (a.s) (2)
